purpose: Validation-only paired screen of a low-rank global channel-state mixer on the frozen fast MambaTSv3 AutoCon H12 traffic configuration.
research_question: Can a one-scan MambaTSv3 state conditioned by an O(C*r) window summary close the METR-LA gap while preserving PEMS-BAY and retaining AutoCon representation learning?
evidence_boundary: All jobs use skip_test=true. No held-out test metrics are generated, read, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: This is a local MambaMixer-inspired optimization, not an official reproduction. It cannot establish universal accuracy, a stable independent AutoCon effect, or publication readiness.
prelaunch_gates: verify data hashes and numeric CSV contracts
freeze the one-factor GCM off/on contrast and all training hyperparameters
require exact paired coverage before computing an architecture contrast

phases.name: mambatsv3_global_channel_mixer_off_h12
phases.purpose: Frozen MambaTSv3 AutoCon control without the global channel-state mixer.

phases.name: mambatsv3_global_channel_mixer_on_h12
phases.purpose: One-factor treatment: the same AutoCon MambaTSv3 plus rank-4 global channel-state FiLM mixer after the shared scan.

phases.name: external_strong_baselines_h12
phases.purpose: Same-budget external baselines; all remain validation-only.

pairing_contract.interpretation: The off/on contrast isolates the global channel-state mixer. External models are same-budget descriptive context.

comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: Validation-only candidate screen; no held-out test or universal claim.

accuracy_gate.mixer_vs_control: METR-LA treatment mean validation MSE must improve by at least 1.0%, win at least 2/3 paired seeds, and no paired seed may degrade by more than 2.0%. PEMS-BAY treatment must be non-inferior to control within 1.0% mean MSE and no paired seed may degrade by more than 2.0%.
accuracy_gate.external_context: The treatment must be within 2.0% of the best same-budget external validation baseline on each dataset before any confirmation test is registered.
accuracy_gate.resource_gate: Use the recorded exact-shape prediction-only preflight; the treatment must remain faster than PatchTST and TimeMixer on METR-LA and PEMS-BAY.
